## Why This Is Asked
Real-world SaaS must meet data residency constraints, not just security per tenant. This question tests architecture for geo-scoped data isolation, cryptographic controls, egress geofencing, and policy enforcement.

## Key Concepts
- Data residency across multi-geo environments
- Per-tenant separation (projects/datasets) and CMEK with rotation
- Private Service Connect and VPC Service Controls for geofenced egress
- Audit trails per tenant in Cloud Logging/Audit Logs
- Policy enforcement with IAM Conditions and an OPA-like runtime check integrated in API layer
- CI/CD validation with synthetic tenants and rollback triggers

## Code Example
```javascript
// Pseudo residency check (illustrative)
function residencyCheck(tenantGeo, resourceGeo) {
  return tenantGeo === resourceGeo;
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
